newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Los Angeles Harbor Dept., Calif..

text.p: NOTICE INVITING PROPOSALS FOR PURCHASE OF BONDS
Harbor Department of the City of Los Angeles
Revenue Bonds, Issue of 1996
$300,000,000* Series B(AMT)
$20,000,000* Series C Refunding
The Board of Harbor Commissioners of The City of Los Angeles intends to receive sealed bids for the above- referenced bonds (the til 9:00 a.m., Pacific Standard Time, on Wednesday
December 4, 1996
at The City of Los Angeles, California, Department of Water
and Power, Room 1555H, 111 North Hope Street, Los Angeles,
California 90012, as described in the Official Notice
Inviting Bids. The Board reserves the right, to the extent
permitted by law, to postpone the date for receiving bids
and establish a subsequent date on which bids are to be
received as more fully set forth in the Official Notice
Inviting Bids. Changes in the date and time of receipt of
proposals will be communicated via Munifacts News Wire not
later than 12:00 p.m., Pacific Standard Time, on the last
business day prior to the bid opening.
All bids must be clearly marked
Proposal for The Harb
Department of the City Los Angeles Revenue Bonds, Issue of
1996, Series B and C''. IF NO ACCEPTABLE BID IS RECEIVED ON
DECEMBER 4, 1996, BIDS WILL RECEIVED AT THE SAME PLACE AND
TIME ON SUCCEEDING WEDNESDAYS, COMMENCING DECEMBER 11, 1996,
UNTIL THE EARLIER OF THE FIRST WEDNESDAY WHEN A BID IS
ACCEPTED OR DECEMBER 31, 1997.
The Board reserves the right to establish a maximum true
interest cost and alter the principal amount for the Bonds.
The Board will notify prospective bidders of any such
maximum true interest cost and principal amount via
Munifacts News Wire not later than 12:00 p.m., Pacific
Standard Time on December 3, 1996. In such event, no bid
will be accepted which specifies a true interest cost
greater than the maximum true interest cost or specifies a
principal amount greater or lesser than the principal amount
established by the Board.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement to be issued
in connection with the sale of the Bonds and the complete
Official Notice Inviting Bids including the Bid Form may be
obtained from the Department or from the office of the
Department's financial advisors at the following locations:
Mr. James P. Preusch
Chief Financial Officer
Harbor Department of
The City of Los Angeles
425 South Palos Verdes Street
San Pedro, CA 90733-0151
or
Public Financial Management, Inc. E.J. De La Rosa & Co Inc.
Two Logan Square, Suite 1600 11900 West Olympic Blvd.,
Suite 500
Philadelphia, PA 19103 Los Angeles, CA 90064-1151
Attn: Daniel Wallick Attn: Brian Richman
The Preliminary Official Statement is in a form deemed
final by the Department within the meaning of Rule 15c2-
12(b)(1) promulgated by the Securities and Exchange
Commission pursuant to the Securities Exchange Act of 1934,
except for the omission of certain information permitted to
be omitted therefrom pursuant to Rule 15C2-12, but is
subject to revision, amendment and completion in a final
Official Statement.
Given by order of the Board of Harbor Commissioners of The
City of Los Angeles, adopted October 23, 1996.
*Preliminary, subject to change
(From The Bond Buyer)
